title: Split Phase

solutions.title: Parse the line, then price the entry
solutions.tradeoff: An intermediate structure you now have to name, maintain and keep honest - a data type that exists for no reason other than that two phases have to meet somewhere.

reviewFocus: Does the intermediate structure carry text or facts? A `membership: string` field means the seam was cut one word too early.
Which phase owns the unknown race code? Looking a price up is pricing; the parser has no price list and must not grow one.
Does the parser import anything about money, or the pricer anything about `|` or string splitting? Either import is the split failing.
Is the discount still capped by the subtotal, and the member percentage still applied to the base alone? Those two are the easiest things to reorder while moving code between phases.
How long is the composed entry point? If it is more than the two calls, some third thing is hiding between the phases.
